title: HOOKS-AUTOMATION-V2-MS0
brief: Claude Code 2.1.89 expanded the hook API from 12 events → 31. PRISM has 480+ hooks but mostly on the old surface. Folding new patterns: `defer` decision, `PermissionDenied{retry:true}`, conditional `if` field, agent-scoped hooks, official hookify plugin loader.
